scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
This is a very strange place...
It's underdeveloped, and there
are a number of complex, winding paths...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
这里还真是个奇怪的地方...
没怎么开发过，小路又多又曲折，让人绕得晕头转向。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
However, since I have been here
for months, I am familiar with
this area's geography and points
of interest in this village.
You're welcome to ask me about the
locations of buildings.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
不过，我在这里待了几个月，已经熟悉了这一带的地形和村里值得一看的地方。
想知道建筑在哪里，随时可以问我。

scripts.text: Locations of buildings.
scripts.translation: 建筑位置

scripts.text: Remove marks on the mini map.
scripts.translation: 移除小地图上的标记

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
So, which one do you want to check?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
那么，您想了解哪个地方？

scripts.text: Chief's House
scripts.translation: 首领的家

scripts.text: Shaman's House
scripts.translation: 萨满的住所

scripts.text: Weapon Shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 道具店

scripts.text: Bungee Jump Place
scripts.translation: 蹦极台

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I have made a ^FF3355+^000000 mark
on your mini map.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
我已经在您的小地图上标了^FF3355+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Only the chief knows the language
of the outside world. So you'd
better visit him before anything else.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
只有首领懂外界的语言。
所以，您最好先去拜访他。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I have made a ^CE6300+^000000 mark
on your mini map.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
我已经在您的小地图上标了^CE6300+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
The Utan Shaman has some
sort of mystic power...
People say she can create rough
enchanted stones, and divide a
pure enchanted stone into rough ones.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
乌坦萨满拥有某种神秘的力量...
据说她能制作属性原石，还能把纯净的属性石分解成原石。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I have made a ^55FF33+^000000 mark
on your mini map.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
我已经在您的小地图上标了^55FF33+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
The Utans are usually well armed
in preparation for attacks from
their enemies. Apparently, they
have been attacked from the outside many times in the past.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
乌坦人通常全副武装，以防敌人袭击。
看来，他们过去曾多次遭到外敌入侵。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I have made a ^3355FF+^000000 mark
on your mini map.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
我已经在您的小地图上标了^3355FF+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
There are many useful things for
traveling in the Tool Shop, so why don't you go look around?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
道具店里有许多旅行时用得上的东西，您不妨去看看？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I have made a ^00FF00+^000000 mark
on your mini map.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
我已经在您的小地图上标了^00FF00+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Umbala has a unique locale called
the 'Bungee Jump Place'.
If you're interested in testing
your courage, why don't you go
and partake in this Utan
ritual yourself?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
汶巴拉有一处特别的地方，叫作“蹦极台”。
想考验一下自己的胆量吗？
不妨亲自去体验这项乌坦仪式。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
If you want to remove the location
marks on your mini map, please
choose 'Remove marks on the mini map' menu.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
如果想移除小地图上的地点标记，请选择“移除小地图上的标记”。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I removed all the marks from your
mini map. Feel free to ask me
again if you want me to mark building locations.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
您小地图上的所有标记都已移除。
想重新标记建筑位置，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
It's fun to learn Utan culture on your own. Take care.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
自己探索乌坦文化也很有趣。
保重。
